interface.name: arctic_display_v1

description.summary: the display hardware behind the outputs

interface.description: Offered by dwm.exe next to wl_output and xdg_output: the graphics adapter, the EDID of each output, and mode setting. The modes are the ones wl_output advertises; the display layout of the Win32 world is applied through a configuration.

event.name: adapter

description.summary: the graphics adapter, sent on bind

event.description: PCI ids are 0 for an adapter that is not a PCI device, such as the firmware framebuffer.

description.summary: what an output is connected to
the monitor's EDID, sent once; empty if it has none

interface.name: arctic_configuration_v1

description.summary: modes and positions for the outputs, applied at once

interface.description: Outputs the configuration does not name keep their mode and position. On apply dwm.exe answers with succeeded or failed; either way the configuration is used up and the client destroys it. Before succeeded, every wl_output that changed has sent its new mode and position.

entry.name: test
entry.summary: only check that the configuration can be shown

entry.name: persist
entry.summary: keep it for this set of monitors, across restarts

arg.name: refresh
arg.summary: mHz, as the wl_output mode event gave it
